headline: Linn of Mercy Boils Over as Weathered Expanse Tips Warden-Ward
war_summary: Three hours beyond our last edition, the Linn of Mercy has overtaken the Weathered Expanse as the war's busiest front, ten base actions logged in the past two hours, Lathair and Rotdust contested almost without pause; its single ruined post lies unrebuilt while ten others fly Colonial colors, and Warden losses now run the heavier in the hourly count. The Weathered Expanse, which led the previous dispatch, has tipped further Warden-ward, six posts to three, Crow's Nest the most fought-over point and activity registered at the very hour of filing. Stonecradle held its six-Colonial, three-Warden line through seventeen recorded actions before roughly three hours of quiet. The Stlican Shelf remains divided five to four as casualties surge anew around Thornhold. Callahans Passage keeps its grim arithmetic, better than a thousand casualties an hour a side, without a base changing hands. The Dead Lands have been still since mid-morning fighting at Callahan's Gate, though their casualty count stirs again, and the Nevish Line bleeds heavily in the day's tally with no base actions logged. Day 314 stands with no victor declared and thirty-four victory towns still the prize.
